label: Avaśya Rakṣibe Kṛṣṇa Song Two
title: tumi to' māribe jāre ke tāre rākhite pāre
incipit: tumi to’ māribe jāre, ke tāre rākhite pāre
metaDescription: Avaśya Rakṣibe Kṛṣṇa Song Two: (tumi to' māribe jāre ke tāre rākhite pāre) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

translit: tumi to’ māribe jāre, ke tāre rākhite pāre,
verses.translation: If You wish to slay someone, then who could possibly protect them? The three worlds are subservient to Your will. The demigods headed by Lord Brahmā are Your countless servants who stand ready to execute Your command.
deva: तुमि तो’ मारिबे जारे, के तारे राखिते पारे,
bengali: তুমি তো’ মারিবে জারে, কে তারে রাখিতে পারে,

verses.translation: By Your will the planets incessantly exercise their auspicious or inauspicious influences. Illness, grief, death, and fear occur by Your will. Your command is all-powerful.

translit: tava bhoye vāyu boy, candra sūrya samudoy,
verses.translation: In fear of You the wind blows, the sun and moon rise and set, all performing their regulated tasks. You are the Supreme Lord, the ultimate spirit, transcendentally situated beyond even the beyond. Your residence is in the heart of Your loving devotee.
deva: तव भोये वायु बोय्, चन्द्र सूर्य समुदोय्,
bengali: তব ভোযে বাযু বোয্, চন্দ্র সূর্য সমুদোয্,

translit: tumi to’ rākhibe jāre, ke tāre mārite pāre,
verses.translation: You are eternally pure. All Your desires are already fulfilled. Your name is Bhakta-vatsala, for You are the eternally affectionate Lord of Your dear devotees. If You wish to protect someone, then who could possibly slay them? You are the law of all laws.
deva: तुमि तो’ राखिबे जारे, के तारे मारिते पारे,
bengali: তুমি তো’ রাখিবে জারে, কে তারে মারিতে পারে,

translit: vipada hoite swāmī! avaśya tāhāre tumi,
verses.translation: Your servant Bhaktivinoda has bowed down submissively at Your lotus feet, O Lord! He cherishes the faith, O master, that You will surely protect him from all dangers.
deva: विपद होइते स्वामी! अवश्य ताहारे तुमि,
bengali: বিপদ হোইতে স্বামী! অবশ্য তাহারে তুমি,

titleDeva: तुमि तोऽ मारिबे जारे के तारे राखिते पारे
titleBengali: তুমি তোঽ মারিবে জারে কে তারে রাখিতে পারে
